hints.title: Building Heights Analogy
hints.text: Think of the array as building columns of specified heights from a base of zero using horizontal block placements.

hints.title: Ascending Steps Add Operations
hints.text: Whenever target[i] exceeds target[i - 1], you must initiate target[i] - target[i - 1] additional operations.

hints.title: Descending Steps Reuse Operations
hints.text: When target[i] is less than or equal to target[i - 1], the current column can be covered by the operations that started earlier.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating block increments by finding range minima takes O(N^2) or O(N log N) segment tree work.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single forward pass counting positive adjacent differences takes O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formalizes that operations are required exactly when the profile climbs upward.
complexity.notes: Initial element target[0] requires target[0] operations.
